parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: The condition that you specify to filter the ACLs. If you do not specify this parameter, all ACLs are queried.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rocketmq list-instance-acl --instance-id rmq-cn-7e22ody0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --filter CID-TEST --region cn-hangzhou
